observations.says: it is dated the third of March
it speaks of Thomas as already christened
Thomas was christened on the first of July, four months after the will's date
Miss Pym died two months before the christening the will speaks of: she could not have written it
the earlier will gives Mrs. Grice the house; this one takes it from her
Mrs. Grice left the day after the funeral, and never came back to the Bible
since her death only Mr. Pym could come at the Bible
the will leaves everything to Mr. Pym
whoever wrote it could copy her hand
